en: The black-and-white postcard shows a scenic riverside town viewed through two tall trees in the foreground. In the background is a quaint townscape with traditional European buildings, a church with a prominent steeple, a bridge crossing the river, and farmlands or forested hills beyond. The text on the postcard reads 'Blick auf Flöha i. Sa.', indicating a view of Flöha in Saxony, Germany.
